hotels.title: Stylish Gladstone Stay at Peppers in the Heart of Town
hotels.description: Overlooking Gladstone Marina, this polished waterfront retreat places you steps from East Shores, where landscaped parklands, a waterfront boardwalk and the East Shores Precinct’s lagoon-style pool shape the city’s coastal rhythm. Contemporary rooms and apartments feature private balconies, with many framing views across the harbour and Curtis Island. Onsite, guests can settle in at the restaurant and bar for modern Australian dining before strolling to nearby Auckland Hill Lookout for sweeping port vistas. Gladstone Regional Art Gallery & Museum and the ferry terminal for Heron Island and Curtis Island sit within easy reach
